html_source: Rosh Hashana offset color lithograph postcard from the early 1900s showing Russian Jews gazing, packs in hand, at American Jews beckoning them to the United States. The eagle of the Russian empire has condoned pogroms. The American eagle holds a banner with the legend "Shelter us in the shadow of your wings" (Psalms 17:8). Source: Wikimedia Commons.

Rosh Hashana offset color lithograph postcard

  at American Jews beckoning them to the United States. The eagle
  of the Russian empire has condoned pogroms. The American eagle
  holds a banner with the legend "Shelter us in the shadow of your
  wings" (Psalms 17:8). Source: Wikimedia Commons.
